text: Harald Pihl GmbH in Krefeld, Germany (managing director Tobias Böke) is listed among the offices of HARALD PIHL, whose headquarters is in Täby, Sweden.
short: Harald Pihl GmbH is the German office of HARALD PIHL, headquartered in Täby, Sweden.
